customKnowledge.topic: Free Vedic Astrology & Kundali Rudraksha Recommendation
customKnowledge.answer: We provide personalized Vedic astrology and birth chart (Kundali) analysis to determine which Mukhi aligns with your Lagna (Ascendant), Moon Rashi, Janma Nakshatra, and current planetary Mahadasha. We also specialize in combinations for pacifying doshas like Shani Sade Sati, Rahu/Ketu afflictions, and Manglik dosha. Visit our Birth Chart Recommendation page on the site or WhatsApp us with your birth details.

Nepal Rudraksha beads are naturally large (20mm to 35mm+), heavy, with deeply defined mukhi furrows (clefts) and high electromagnetic potential. Indonesian (Java) beads are naturally smaller (8mm to 16mm), smoother, and lightweight. Both are sacred and authentic per ancient scriptures. Nepal beads are prized for individual collector pendants and high-intensity spiritual practice, while Indonesian beads are preferred for comfortable everyday 108-bead Japa Malas.

Orders within Canada typically arrive in 2–4 business days. USA shipments take 3–6 business days via tracked expedited services. International worldwide delivery takes 5–10 business days depending on destination. Every parcel is safely packed in sacred velvet pouches, insured, and provided with full online tracking.

customKnowledge.topic: Sarva Siddha Mala & Indra Mala Combinations
customKnowledge.answer: The Siddha Mala is a supreme Vedic combination comprising 1 to 14 Mukhi beads plus Gauri Shankar and Ganesh Rudraksha, representing all principal deities and pacifying all 9 planets (Navagrahas). The Indra Mala extends from 1 to 21 Mukhi with Gauri Shankar and Trijuti, considered the crown jewel of all spiritual treasures. Each bead is hand-selected and lab-certified.

All sacred Rudraksha beads and combinations listed in our online catalogue with pricing are in stock and available for immediate sale. customKnowledge.answer: You can order online 24/7 on our website! Browse our catalogue, select your desired Rudraksha, and click 'Add to Sacred Cart' or 'Buy Now'. Then open your Sacred Cart drawer from the top right and proceed to checkout using our fast Guest Checkout—no password or account registration required. Alternatively, you can message our team on WhatsApp at +1 437-267-1257 to place orders directly or request custom silver/gold stringing.

No account or login is required to order from Shiva Rudraksha Inc.! Anyone can checkout quickly as a guest with just their delivery address and email.
